metadata.clinical_analog: Detección de intruso semántico (BEA) / Semantic intruder detection
metadata.description: Odd-one-out test: given 4 words (3 from one category + 1 intruder), identify which word does not belong. Includes two difficulty levels: 'hard' (intruder from adjacent category with semantic overlap) and 'easy' (intruder from distant category with clear boundary).
